dogecoin.text:
$DOGE Dogecoin Weekly Chart.

The breakdown move stopped at the 0.618 Fibonacci level where it found support and even managed to close the week above, which is good. 

Still below the 5, 8, and 21EMA. Needs to get above them for further upside potential. https://t.co/sFBIAUeifv

Dogecoin $DOGE log Fibonacci price targets for this cycle. 

Additionally to these targets, I want to add something: 
The selloff during the last weeks was on very declining volumes and ended right around the 0.5 Fibonacci level, which was flipped from resistance to support.

It https://t.co/FRb7NsnMBM

The same is happening across the board on other #altcoins, and also on Dogecoin $DOGE. 

All the coins, and also many stocks, are primed for a bounce on the (potentially soft) CPI data. https://t.co/uP2juIUovg
